title: Calligram outline
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 95 (Calligram outline (printable or drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 95: Writing and sharing our calligrams. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Top of the glass: a flame of questions
Middle: flickers through the dark corridors of not-yet-knowing
Base: and lights my steps to Year 7

panels.title: Present it
points: Explain why you chose the shape

keywords.def: a poem where the words form a picture

questions.q: Draft your first line inside the shape
questions.a: A first line in the outline

questions.q: Core: write your calligram neatly into the shape
Extend: present your calligram and explain the shape
Stretch: give two classmates specific feedback
questions.a: For example: Your key's teeth used short, sharp words.

questions.q: Which line is the most vivid?
options: a flame that flickers in the dark
questions.a: B) a flame that flickers in the dark. flickers is a precise verb and dark adds contrast.
